g.text: Historical data: Horowitz et al. and Rupp; modern additions use cited manufacturer and SPEC sources.
Filled markers: GPU or GPU component; outlined: CPU/other. FP32 shapes: discrete GPU triangle, integrated GPU square, APU GPU diamond.
Shipping through 2026-09-22. Series-specific units and multipliers; compare trends, not cross-series heights.
